description: Recommend the best AI node + model for a task, with an enforceable cost estimate and human-readable reasons. Use this first when you know the task but not the model. Features (task class, size, language, needs) are extracted LOCALLY from `task` and only those features are sent to the registry — the prompt never leaves this machine. Returns ranked candidates with score components, a cost estimate pinned to the node's card revision, an optional cheaper two-step scenario, and MCP tool categories the task likely needs. For RAG or document Q&A tasks ("answer questions over 2,000 internal documents") it also returns roles.embed: embedding models to index the collection, with an indexing cost estimate; private collections favour models that run on the user's own machine. To browse instead, use search_offerings; to price a specific chain, use estimate.

est_output_tokens.description: Expected answer length in tokens, if known. Improves the cost estimate; otherwise inferred from the task.

policy.description: Optional constraints and preferences for the recommendation.

jurisdiction.description: Only operators in this jurisdiction: "eea" or ISO country codes ("DE,FI"). Local and LAN models always qualify.

local_memory_gb.description: RAM/VRAM this machine can give a local model, in GB. Local models that cannot fit are left out, and the largest size that fits is picked (4-bit estimate). The local stdio server fills this from the machine when it is not given; otherwise catalogue models are scored for a typical 16 GB laptop, and none is picked.

max_input_per_mtok.description: Maximum input price in USD per million tokens.

max_total_usd.description: Maximum estimated total cost of the call in USD.

min_tier.description: Exclude offerings below this trust tier.

prefer_local.description: Give a bonus to nodes on this machine or LAN.

preset.description: Weighting preset: cheap favours price, fast favours latency/throughput, quality favours model strength, private favours trust tier.

region.description: Required data region, e.g. "CA" or "EU" (EU and EEA include their member states). Offerings pinned to, or served from, other regions are excluded, and so are hosted offerings with no known location; models on this machine or LAN always qualify.

task.description: The task description or the prompt itself, e.g. "Translate this Polish contract to English and list the risks". Analysed locally; not sent.

name: recommend
title: Recommend a node and model
